nom: Estée Lauder Mini DayWear Advanced Multi-Protection Anti-Oxidant 24H Moisturizer Crème SPF 15

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin say it absorbs without feeling greasy, though the reviewer with purely oily skin recommends a thin layer to avoid it sitting heavy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, especially in cold or dry climates, describe it as thick, rich, and strongly hydrating, though a couple note it's on the lighter side for very dry skin or a dry vacation climate.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say it balances dry patches and an oily T-zone without an oily appearance or extra shine.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation and some redness reduction, but its noticeable fragrance is flagged as unsuitable for those with fragrance sensitivities.
segments.normal: Reviewers who describe normal or normal-to-combination skin call it a reliable, fuss-free daily moisturizer that keeps skin comfortable without heaviness.
segments.mature: Reviewers focused on anti-aging, including one in her 40s with deepening fine lines, use it as part of a preventive routine and report plumper, smoother-looking skin rather than a dramatic reduction in existing wrinkles.

concerns.aging: Reviewers mostly use this as a preventive part of an anti-aging routine and report plumper, smoother-looking skin; none describe a dramatic reduction in existing fine lines, and a couple say they are still waiting to see results with continued use.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including several with dry skin or in cold/dry climates, describe long-lasting hydration without greasiness; a couple say it feels too light for very dry skin or an especially dry climate and would prefer the brand's heavier 72-hour version.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report reduced redness with regular use, including one with rosacea who says it visibly tones down redness through its green-tinted formula; one reviewer instead reports burning and tearing around the eyes, which she attributes to the chemical sunscreen.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with combination/oily skin says the texture felt substantial enough that her skin barrier was being cared for, without leaving her feeling greasy.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her dark spots faded and her skin looked more even after a few months of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers say it doesn't cause breakouts, including some who are acne-prone; one reviewer with oily skin reports breakouts during the first few uses before her skin adjusted.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers with oily or combination skin say it absorbs without a greasy or shiny finish and even helps control shine, though one with oily skin says it sits a bit thick unless applied in a thin layer.

aspects.libelle: Fragrance is noticeable and can feel strong
Layers well under makeup without pilling
SPF 15 seen as too low on its own
Luxurious jar packaging with gold lid
Price feels steep to some buyers

extraits.texte: The 24 hour wear does not feel as heavy to me as the 72 hour version, and the SPF element in the 24 hour wear did not bother my sensitive skin like the 72 hour did. However I have a harder time getting Estee Lauder products to absorb into my skin than other brands of moisturizer. Even when using a small amount it feels greasy on my face, so day wear is definitely the only option for me with removal before bed. Otherwise I can see the moisturizer transfer to my pillowcase at night. I think I'll stick to other brands personally. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

extraits.titre: Moderate moisture, chem spf may irritate
extraits.texte: I used this SPF Moisturizer in the mornings and would layer it under a higher SPF mineral sunscreen if I was going to be exposed to UV. It has luxurious packaging and a fresh scent, with a medium amount of moisturization; I would recommend an extra moisturizing product under it for other folks with dry skin. I ended up not being able to moisturize around my eyes with it as it would make them burn and tear, which after some research I learned may have been from the chemical sunscreen. It leaves a shine on your skin and blends much better under makeup than mineral sunscreens. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. I enjoyed using this product for many reasons. I am very picky when it comes to my skincare because Im a combo/oily skinned girly, that wears a fully face of makeup regularly. I do have some acne and at 37 Im staring to see signs of aging. So I choose my skincare VERY meticulously and I struggle with finding moisturizers that hydrate but dont leave me feeling greasy, but that can also be worn under my makeup without it separating. This products gel formula allowed moistuization without leaving me greasy but felt thick enough that I knew my skins barrier was taken care of. It does have a scent to it but its not at all offensive, in fact I think its beautifully scented. It definitely gives spa vibes. The fact that its got an spf of 15 is a plus but ALWAYS apply a separate sunscreen for maximum sun protection. I wore this under makeup everyday, with and without primer and it did not peel or separate. I thouroughly enjoyed using this and plan to purchase a new jar when I run out.

I'm 41 with dry skin and my first fine lines getting deeper. I found DayWear to be very moisturizing and hydrating. My skin looked slightly dewy, but not greasy. It's really thick in the jar, but spreads easily so it doesn't feel like you're wearing 50 layers of goo on your face. 2 negatives for me are the scent and low SPF. There's a kind of cucumber floral smell that is really intense. It doesn't smell bad, per se, but those with fragrance sensitivities should pass on this one. No one applies enough moisturizer to get full sunscreen protection, so the SPF in this is probably more like a 5. Fine if you're staying indoors, but definitely not adequate for anything else. Tldr: I think DayWear Moisturizer is a good moisturizer for people who want a simple but effective anti-aging and hydrating routine. Just watch out if you're sensitive to fragrance, or don't use a separate sunscreen. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This moisturizer has been great to use. My favorite part is the green tone it has. It completely tones down my redness throughout the day (I have rosacea) and looks great/ protects from the sun. I highly recommend it for people with redness. "I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

extraits.titre: Perfect for the girlies with sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin that will breakout at the wrong product easily. I have been unable to find a moisturizer, let alone a sunscreen that doesn't make me regret my choice until now! I was unsure about estee lauder as a younger woman with a darker skintone but, I was so wrong! I have been using this for a few months now and my skin looks dewy, moisturized, some of my dark spots have completely faded and my skin looks alive and even. The quality of the product is very much reflected in the price and it is absolutely worth it, will be restocking! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. And I would not have tried it if it wasn't for the free testing - sincerely I do not sugar coat my reviews, this product is actually really good.

I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. I have been using this as my morning moisturizer for the last two weeks. It's fantastic for my normal, slightly dehydrated skin. It's creamy and hydrating but not greasy. I appreciate the spf 15, but I always layer a stronger spf over if I plan on being outdoors. The cucumber scent is very pleasant, although it is a bit stronger than I would like in a face product.
